facts.note: Girard refuses to show his watch at dinner. After dinner he sits alone in the dining room with the brandy, hears the temple strike ten there, and says he did not look at his watch.
He goes out to smoke at twenty-one minutes past ten by his watch and stays under the front windows of the house.
The piano starts in the salon just as he lights his cigar, at twenty-nine minutes past ten by his watch.
At twenty-six minutes to eleven by his watch he hears faint quick bells from the master's window up above.
He comes back into the house at fourteen minutes to eleven by his watch. The hall clock has just struck eleven and its face shows two minutes past eleven. He goes straight up to Félix in the library.
